skala_special_else_if_treatment #

Whether else if is written on one line. ⚠ Measured 2026-08-30 and two-directional: at false the oracle SPLITS a joined else if and lets the if become what it structurally is, the else's embedded statement one level in; at true it joins a split one. Skala had the join arm only — ShouldJoin is the one place phase 1 removes a break — so false left the pair joined. MustBreak now carries the other direction.

Typetrue / false
